project: AI-Powered C/Python Compiler with Security Gate
summary: Implemented comprehensive security pre-scan system with interactive user approval for both C and Python, enriched with CWE references, detailed future risk explanations, consistent semantic agent-manipulation detection (tested against untitled1.c), and a 'Run Anyway' user override option.

features_implemented.name: Interactive Security Prescan Endpoint
features_implemented.description: New POST /api/security/prescan endpoint that performs full static security analysis BEFORE repair or execution. Returns structured findings, risk level, CWE IDs, future risks, and whether user approval is required.

features_implemented.name: Pre-Repair Security Gating in UI
features_implemented.description: runRepair() now calls prescanCode() BEFORE any model invocation. If security issues found, shows modal with full explanation. User can click 'Acknowledge & Proceed with Repair' or 'Proceed with Repair Anyway'.

features_implemented.name: Python Dangerous Function Detection
features_implemented.description: Added comprehensive Python dangerous function database with 15 function entries and 21 regex detection patterns. Each entry includes description, CWE ID, severity, and detailed future risk explanations.

features_implemented.name: C Future Risk Database
features_implemented.description: Added detailed future risk explanations for 9 C dangerous functions. Each finding now includes a future_risks array with 2-4 specific risk explanations including attack vectors and consequences.

features_implemented.name: CWE and Future Risks in Security Modal UI
features_implemented.description: Security approval modal renders CWE Reference tags and 'Possible Future Risks' bullet list for each finding, between Potential Consequences and Recommended Mitigation.
ui_elements_added: CWE Reference badge (styled red tag with mono font)
Future Risks bullet list with warning icon header

features_implemented.name: Semantic Agent-Manipulation Classifier (Multi-Language)
features_implemented.description: Rule-based classifier evaluating multi-dimensional prompt injection and agent manipulation without hardcoded per-file patterns. Detects directive headers (SECURITY TEST:, SYSTEM OVERRIDE:), policy/rule suppression, agent commands (tell the agent to approve), report falsification (report program is safe, claim clean), and validation disabling in C and Python comments or strings.
features_implemented.test_case_verified: examples/untitled1.c verified blocked with CWE-94 and future_risks

features_implemented.name: Run Anyway Override Option
features_implemented.description: Added user-controlled 'Run Anyway (Override Security Warnings)' / 'Proceed with Repair Anyway' capability. When the compiler or repair is blocked due to security vulnerabilities or policy warnings, the modal allows the user to explicitly force execution after reviewing all potential threats and future risks.

parameters.audit_logging: Recorded as FORCE_OVERRIDE_APPROVED in audit trail

features_implemented.name: SecurityReporter & Precheck Findings Enrichment
features_implemented.description: Findings from PreExecutionSecurityGate and SecurityReporter (gets, strcpy, sprintf, agent manipulation, etc.) are enriched with cwe_id and future_risks from risk databases during evaluate().

features_implemented.name: Python Syntax Analysis in Prescan
features_implemented.description: When language='python', prescan uses py_compile instead of ANTLR to validate Python syntax. Errors are reported as findings.

features_implemented.name: SecurityApprovalGateFinding Enhanced Dataclass
features_implemented.description: Added cwe_id (str) and future_risks (List[str]) fields to SecurityApprovalGateFinding dataclass. Both are included in to_dict() output for API responses.
